projects.title: Unarmed
projects.description: A 3D Roguelike Game developed in the Godot Engine. It is a passion project between me and a friend of mine. The game is a work in progress, and is a FPS set in a dystopian cyberpunk, delving into the possible consequence of AI use and the inversion of society as a result of technology.

projects.title: Blinkey
projects.description: A facial recognition app that manages entry authorization. Movement and detection is sparked by blinking.

projects.title: UFC Predictor
projects.description: A ML model that predicts the outcome of UFC fights based on fighter statistics and match history prior to the fight. It starts by creating a fighter profile from their fight history prior (up to 6 fights) and then uses that profile against the other in order to generate a prediction (with probabilities). It also comes with a webscraper built to scrape fight data from a fighter off of UFCstats.com. It scrapes, formats, updates, checks if fighter is available for training, and checks what fighters are needed to be added to training data.

projects.title: Project ESPER
projects.description: A project that attempts to recreate ChatGPT on a Macbook Pro M4. It is a sandbox project for me to exercise a plethora of techniques to learn, optimize, and recreate the performance and intelligence of large language models on consumer hardware.
